club_1000.title: The 1,000-yard club
club_1000.hist: history: 33% over, 43% healthy; the 1,000-1,200 band is the dead zone, 1,200+ has held up

bounceback.title: Bounce-back backs (missed time in 2025)
bounceback.hist: history: 64% over, 85% when healthy, median +108 -- the market over-discounts a back's injury year

bullish_rerate.title: Line set well above last year (bullish re-rate)
bullish_rerate.hist: history: 57% over, 8-for-8 when healthy -- for backs, a raise has still been too low

dead_zone_800_1000.title: The 800-1,000 bimodal band
dead_zone_800_1000.hist: history: 71% over when healthy, but the misses (injuries) run ~1.4x the size of the beats

committee_trap.title: Deep backs with a real line -- the committee trap
committee_trap.hist: history: RB31+ by draft cost cleared 1 of 11 (9%)

elite_qb.title: Elite-QB backfields (lean over, unlike WR)
elite_qb.hist: history: tier-1-QB RBs cleared 58% (73% healthy) -- the opposite of the WR finding

new_team.title: New team or new role in 2026
new_team.hist: priced on a situation with no shared history -- treat the line as a wider guess

watch.source_note: 2026 rushing-yards numbers are First Down Studio's Vegas-prop-driven projection (~within 25 yds of posted DK season O/U); QB tier from The Athletic's 2026 survey; win total is the current Kalshi line; 2025 figures are actual regular-season totals.
